verifiedBy: wrapper (real packaged .app, real CDP-driven UI + Node inspector, not codex's degraded ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE pass)

method.build: npm run build (build:ext + theia build --mode production)
method.package: npm run package (electron-builder --dir, target=dir, platform=darwin arch=arm64)
method.launch: packaged .app executable launched directly with --remote-debugging-port (renderer CDP) and --inspect (main-process Node inspector), --user-data-dir isolated under <SCRATCH>, --no-sandbox
method.nativeDialogHandling: main-process Node inspector used to monkeypatch electron.dialog.showOpenDialog to auto-resolve to the target scratch destination (native OS dialogs are not CDP-drivable, matching the task's stated constraint)

trials.name: direct RPC proxy call
trials.how: window.theia.container resolved via CDP Runtime.evaluate; AkariProjectService looked up by its inversify Symbol and createProject(destUri) invoked directly on the real DI-bound backend proxy of the running packaged app

trials.name: full UI-driven flow
trials.how: CDP Input domain: F1 to open the quick-command palette, Input.insertText to filter to '新規プロジェクト作成', mouse click dispatched at the resolved row's bounding rect, native dialog auto-resolved via the main-process patch above
trials.result: dialog.showOpenDialog invoked exactly once (instrumented call counter), createProject completed, workspace.open side effect observed (.akari/render-pins.json appeared post-commit)

packaging.note: electron-builder's default excludedNames strips .gitignore and .gitkeep from the asar (confirmed via `npx @electron/asar list` and `extract`); only CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/settings.json, .claude/skills/README.md, .akari/workflow.json ship inside app.asar/lib/templates/project-default. createProject's writeFallbackTemplate no-overwrite pass fills the rest.

byteComparison.method: cmp -s against files extracted from the actual packaged app.asar (npx @electron/asar extract), and against the repository's templates/project-default/.gitignore for the asar-stripped file

createProjectRuns.note: 13th file (.akari/render-pins.json) is a post-commit runtime artifact from workspace.open()/watchProject(), not part of the template

environmentNotes: A long-idle test instance (kept alive across ~1h of interactive UI-automation debugging) entered a stuck 'reconnecting channel' state on the frontend<->backend RPC connection, causing createProject calls to hang/no-op silently with no error toast. This was an artifact of the debugging session's idle time, not a defect in the createProject fix itself: killing the stale instance and relaunching fresh immediately reproduced success on both the direct-proxy and full-UI-driven paths.
No local absolute paths, working-directory names, or session identifiers are recorded in this evidence file.
